The Oct 23 reading (reflecting Oct 22) will have ~8 days of post-CPI responses, so the full impact of the hot inflation data should be more completely incorporated into the smoothed model.

Net directional push: approximately +1.5 to +2.5 from 59.6.

Pre-mortem:** If wrong, most likely because the MRP smoothing absorbs the CPI shock more slowly than expected, or the Oct 16 drop to 59.6 already partially reflected post-CPI data, limiting further upward movement.
